evals.prompt: 오늘 할 일 브리핑해줘. 지난 항목, 오늘 마감, 이번 주 예정, 기한 없는 항목을 나눠서 보여줘.
evals.expected_output: Uses a bounded incomplete-reminder read, states the local date and timezone, groups items into the four requested buckets, treats this week as through Sunday, caps no-due-date output, and reports truncation without exposing unrelated notes.

assertions.text: The response states the local date/timezone basis and uses only bounded read commands
The response separates overdue, due today, later this week, and no due date
No-due-date output is capped at 20 and any omitted or truncated count is reported
Unrelated notes and raw reminder JSON are not exposed

evals.prompt: 쇼핑 목록에 우유 사기를 오늘 저녁 7시로 추가해줘.
evals.expected_output: Creates one reminder in the Shopping list with an explicit local ISO due time, then reads back the affected scope and reports the created reminder ID.

assertions.text: Uses apple-reminders create with title, list, and due time
Verifies the created reminder with a follow-up read

evals.expected_output: Lists a bounded active scope first, refuses to guess when duplicate titles exist, deletes only by one resolved reminder ID, and verifies that exact item no longer appears as active.

assertions.text: The target is resolved from current list output before delete
No title-only or bulk guess is used for deletion

evals.prompt: 이 스크린샷을 취업캠프 준비 미리알림에 첨부해줘.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the built-in Minis reminder command does not support attachments and does not fabricate an attach command or claim success.

assertions.text: The response states that reminder attachments are unsupported
The response suggests a feature request or supported product path

evals.prompt: 프로젝트 제출 미리알림의 제목만 '프로젝트 최종 제출'로 바꿔줘. 날짜랑 메모는 그대로 둬.
evals.expected_output: Reads current candidates, resolves one reminder ID, updates only the title, preserves due date and notes, and verifies the changed title.

assertions.text: Only the requested title field is changed
The response includes a post-update verification read
